text: In Lean 4 / Mathlib4, the `CategoryTheory` library models morphisms as:
choices: elements of a set Hom(X,Y) with a definitional associativity law
bundled structures (category as a typeclass over an object type, with Hom as a field)
explanation: Mathlib4 CategoryTheory: `Category C` is a typeclass on C: Type with `Hom: C → C → Type`, `comp`, `id`, and associativity/unit as proof fields. This allows universe-polymorphic categories.
